sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Violent ache as if top of head would come
off — eyes felt as if pushed out.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Leaden, dead feeling after or between
meals; flatulence and sour eructations.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless and wakeful, resulting from ex-
haustion. Insomnia of infants and the aged, and the
mentally worried, and overworked, with tendency to
convulsions. Nocturnal cough.
